text: Bring one of each soft material into the nest.
Gently rub around the nest to make the lining smooth.
Gently rub each egg to warm it. Watch the ducklings hatch!
Bring the seed packet to each patch of soil.
Bring the watering can to each little plant. Watch it grow!
Pull the carrots from the soil and carry them to your basket.
Rub each muddy carrot with your finger to wash it clean.
Bring a carrot to each friend. You grew them yourself!
Look at the weather picture. Bring Cloud the clothes she needs.
Rub each puddle with your finger and make a little splash!
Tap each little flower patch to gather the meadow flowers.
Rub over each pile of fluttering leaves to gather them.
Hang the matching clothes on the line. Look at the weather picture.
Bring a wooden peg to each piece of washing.
Swipe your finger back and forth through the washing to help it dry.
Carry each piece of dry washing from the line into your basket.
Look at each friend's little picture. Bring the snack they want.
Both friends need a drink. Bring fresh water to each bowl.
Bring the ball to each friend. Everyone can join our game!
Choose a picture stamp and put it on your postcard.
Match the friend on your postcard to their letterbox. Carry it over.
